onboarding.welcomeBody: Your personal coach that knows your health data and supports you every day.

privacyPoints.local: All health data is stored only on this phone, in an encrypted database.
privacyPoints.ai: It is sent only to the AI provider you choose, only when needed and in summarised form.
privacyPoints.noServer: None of our servers receive, store or process your health data.

onboarding.disclaimer: AlbA is a wellness and information tool, not a medical device. It does not provide diagnoses or replace the advice of a doctor.
onboarding.acceptDisclaimer: I have read and accept the medical disclaimer

errors.dbUnlockBody: The encrypted database cannot be unlocked on this device. You can try again or reset local data and start over.
errors.resetConfirmBody: All data stored in the app will be permanently deleted. Data in Apple Health / Health Connect is not affected.

ai.title: Choose your coach's intelligence
ai.subtitle: The easiest way is to use the AI already built into your phone: free, private, no account.

providers.anthropic: Claude models. Strong reasoning, with a focus on safety.
providers.openai: GPT models, the same ones behind ChatGPT.
providers.gemini: Google's Gemini models, with a free tier to get started.

anthropic.1: Open the Anthropic Console and sign in or create an account.
anthropic.2: Under Billing, add a payment method or prepaid credit.
anthropic.3: Go to API Keys and tap "Create Key"; give it a name such as AlbA.
anthropic.4: Tap "Copy" next to the key and close the page: the code will be filled in and verified automatically.

openai.1: Open the OpenAI platform and sign in or create an account.
openai.2: Under Billing, add credit: a ChatGPT subscription does not cover the API.
openai.3: Go to API keys and tap "Create new secret key".
openai.4: Tap "Copy" next to the key and close the page: the code will be filled in and verified automatically.

gemini.1: Open Google AI Studio and sign in with your Google account.
gemini.2: Tap "Create API key" and choose or create a project.
gemini.3: Tap "Copy" next to the key and close the page: the code will be filled in and verified automatically.

ai.openKeysPage: Open the page and create the code
ai.billingNote: AI usage is billed by the provider to your account, based on consumption. Your key stays on this phone: we never receive or see it.
ai.keyHint: It is stored in your phone's secure keychain.
ai.keySavedHint: A key is already saved. Paste a new one only if you want to replace it.

errors.invalid_key: The API key is invalid or lacks the required permissions. Check it and try again.
errors.insufficient_credit: Your account credit with the provider has run out. Top it up in the provider's console.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.network: No or unstable connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.server: The AI provider is temporarily overloaded or unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.model_not_found: The selected model is not available for this key. Choose another one.
errors.refused: The model could not answer this request. Try rephrasing it.
errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred with the AI provider.
errors.device_unavailable: The phone's AI isn't available right now. Check that it's turned on, or use an online service.
errors.context_window: This conversation is too long for the phone's AI. Start a new conversation.
errors.unsupported_language: The phone's AI doesn't support this language. Change language or use an online service.
errors.org_verification: OpenAI requires your organization to be verified for this model. Verify it on platform.openai.com (Settings → Organization) or choose another model.
errors.app_update_required: This feature needs the latest version of the app. Install the latest update and try again.
errors.billing_required: Google requires billing to be enabled to use Gemini from your region (Switzerland, EU, UK). In Google AI Studio open "Billing", add a payment method to the key's project and try again.

sources.title: Connect your data
sources.subtitle: The coach reads your data from {{source}}. You can choose, type by type, what to share.
sources.readOnly: Read-only: {{name}} never writes or changes anything.

activity.title: Activity
activity.why: Steps, distance, floors, calories and workouts, to follow your movement and progress.

heart.title: Heart
heart.why: Heart rate, resting heart rate, HRV and VO2max, for recovery, stress and fitness.

sleep.title: Sleep
sleep.why: Sleep duration and stages, to understand how well you really rest.

body.title: Body
body.why: Weight, height, BMI, body fat and lean mass, to follow your body composition.

vitals.title: Vitals
vitals.why: Blood pressure, glucose, oxygen saturation, breathing and temperature, also for safety alerts.

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.why: Calories, macronutrients, water and caffeine logged by your food apps.

cycle.title: Menstrual cycle
cycle.why: To read energy, sleep and symptoms in relation to your cycle.

mindfulness.title: Mindfulness
mindfulness.why: Minutes of meditation and breathing, for mental wellbeing.

sources.installHealthConnect: On this Android version you need Google's Health Connect app. Install it from the Play Store, then come back here.
sources.unavailable: {{source}} is not available on this device.
sources.androidHistoryNote: We will also ask for background and history access: without them, Health Connect only allows reading the last 30 days.
sources.noneGrantedBody: You can enable permissions at any time in the {{source}} settings.
sources.otherAppsBody: Many apps already write to {{source}}: MyFitnessPal, Cronometer, Yazio, Samsung Health, smart scales and blood pressure monitors, sleep and meditation apps. Their data reaches the coach with no extra steps.
sources.otherAppsHowIOS: To enable them: open the app (e.g. MyFitnessPal) → Settings → Connected apps & devices → Health, and allow writing. Or in the Health app → profile → Apps.
sources.otherAppsHowAndroid: To enable them: open the app (e.g. Samsung Health or Yazio) → Settings → Health Connect, and allow writing data.
sources.comingSoonBody: Direct connections with other services and devices will arrive in upcoming updates.
